verified.rule: Entry implementation. His literal morning 1/5-min trigger measured −2.2% CAGR with 13% winners after spreads. The rootchunhe 15:55 close-confirm proxy measured 12.1% CAGR, Sharpe 0.83, roughly equal to QQQ. Options: one of them, or both as paper variants (https://github.com/rootchunhe/martin-luk-backtesting).
Risk per trade: 0.3%, 0.5% or 0.5-1%. He has used all three over time.
Position cap: a 35% cap (2024 rule; Kyna's Jan 2026 post) or no cap (2025, VKNEJA5r8zw 16:37-18:02).
Gross exposure / margin: up to 280% in his account; what the paper account allows.
Exit precedence among 3R/5R trims, the 9 EMA close, the 21/50 EMA early trail and the parabolic rule. He has no hard sell rule, and "really extended on the 1-hour" is undefined.
"Really fast flush" into hourly EMA support has no number.
Anchored VWAP anchor choice (base swing high/low, gap day, 250-day high per rootchunhe) is not specified.
Market gate as a hard rule. Whether M3 (index 9<21) becomes a gate, and what QQQ distance from its 9 EMA blocks longs (M2 is one example only).
Potent-screen industry exclusion list is not visible in the frames.
Earnings blackout of 5 days ~95% of the time comes from the fan FAQ only; it needs confirming from the stream.
Max hold: none stated by Luk; rootchunhe used 15 days (third-party).
Shorts: in or out of scope (his short rules: https://tradingresourcehub.substack.com/p/martin-luk-study-process).
Exposure building and watchlist tier overrides are by his judgment, with no rule.
Unread primary: his May 2025 X post on pullback entry tactics (cited by him at VKNEJA5r8zw 1:00:15).

Promotion: results are regime-bound (the ten best trades = 111% of P&L; 2025 is about a third of it; the 9 EMA is a fragile peak; no clean out-of-sample period). Any lane goes through the strategy-lab prereg (OOS + placebo + DSR) and paper only on HIS CALL.
